title: Mauve Chinon Sequin Embroidered Anarkali Suit Set with Deep Back & Dupatta
description:
Sitara means "star" – a soft mauve scattered with tiny sequins that catch the light like stars on a festive night.

Made to move. This mauve chinon Anarkali falls into a full, fluid flare that swirls with every step, embroidered all over with delicate sequin butis. The front has a graceful round neckline, while the back opens into a deep U with a tie-up dori and tassels – a little surprise for every photo. Gathered churidar sleeves add a romantic, slightly vintage touch. The matching chinon dupatta is embroidered with butis and edged in a fine lace border.

✦ The Details
• Round neckline in front, deep U-back with tie-up dori and tassels
• All-over sequin buti embroidery on the Anarkali
• Full churidar sleeves gathered at the wrist
• Fitted bodice with a full, flowy Anarkali flare
• Matching cotton pants
• Chinon dupatta with sequin butis and lace border

✦ Fabric & Craft
Chinon is a soft, fluid fabric with a gentle natural sheen – lighter than silk, richer than georgette, and it drapes beautifully. The sequin butis are embroidered across the Anarkali and dupatta for an even, all-over sparkle. Comfortable cotton pants keep you at ease through long celebrations.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Pearl chandbalis, soft open curls and a small bindi for a sangeet or reception; leave your hair to one side so the deep back shows. Clear or nude heels keep the look light, and a silver potli finishes it.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
set_items: Anarkali Kurta (chinon, sequin embroidery, deep back)
care: Dry clean only. Store folded in a muslin cloth with tissue over the sequins. Steam or iron on low heat on the reverse side.
